2fa0ca06e65b0245.title: Craft 'n Chat — Make new friends while crafting!
2fa0ca06e65b0245.desc: Come for the crafts, stay for your new best friend! Have you ever thought about how hard it is to make friends as an adult? You are not alone, but the Burbank Library is here to help and what better way than with the shared interest of crafting! We will provide soft music, snacks, and conversation starters to help break the ice. We will also have a craft ready for you to learn, but please feel free to bring your own craft to work on. There’s no pressure to do the exact same crafts, we’re all here to make friends! We can't wait to craft 'n chat with you!

2f00eef2f025215d.title: Al Jardine & The Pet Sounds Band
2f00eef2f025215d.desc: Al Jardine & The Pet Sounds Band The Music of Brian Wilson and The Beach Boys Pet Sounds and Love You Thu Oct 22 | 8PM The Beach Boys founder Al Jardine gathers the Pet Sounds Band to share the best of band co-founder Brian Wilson. Wilson, who died in June 2025, was often called the soul of The Beach Boys’ sound and was responsible for the melodies and lyrics of many of their songs, creating the soundtrack for millions around the world. “Together, we gave the world the American dream of optimism, joy, and a sense of freedom,” the band said on Wilson’s passing. Come sing along with friends and fans to celebrate Wilson and the 60th anniversary of the Pet Sounds album in a concert that you won’t hear anywhere else in L.A.
